author: EDJM9
body:
I'm confused on this. Isn't the point of the report system to report all players? So why cant we report mods if we have a good reason (video evidence.) 

Also I think there should be a way to "impeach" staff.

title: Reporting Staff on TS

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body: It's report a player. We deal with staff members separately, the report the player tab is only meant for reporting players who break the rules.
